WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) as avg_product_price,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    AVG(avg_product_price) as avg_price,
    AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY town_city
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM step2
)
SELECT 
  s2.town_city,
  s2.avg_price,
  s2.avg_ratio,
  s2.avg_ratio - s3.overall_avg_ratio as difference
FROM step2 s2
CROSS JOIN step3 s3
WHERE s3.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s2.avg_ratio > s3.overall_avg_ratio
